description: This file defines the CatalogItem class representing an entity for catalog items in the application, including properties, constructors, and methods to update item details, brand, type, and picture URI.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a catalog item with properties such as Name, Description, Price, PictureUri, and relationships to CatalogType and CatalogBrand. Contains methods for updating details, brand, type, and picture URI. Implements IAggregateRoot.

classes.name: CatalogItem.CatalogItemDetails
classes.description: Record struct for encapsulating details used to update a CatalogItem, including optional Name and Description, and mandatory Price.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing a CatalogItem with given type ID, brand ID, description, name, price, and picture URI.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the CatalogItem's Name, Description, and Price after validating inputs using guard clauses.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the CatalogBrandId after ensuring it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the CatalogTypeId after ensuring it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Sets the PictureUri based on the provided picture name; clears it if null or empty.
